items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 27 November 2026 8:45am
items.description:
##Today##

The rest of the day will be dry with sunny spells soon developing. Cloud will then thicken again tonight. Light and variable winds, becoming light to moderate southeast tonight. Maximum temperature 10°C. Comments: Nil.

SE


##Wind##

##Visibility##

##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

A mainly dry and cloudy start tomorrow, before a band of rain moves across from late morning through the afternoon, clearing in the evening with clear spells following. Fresh to strong southeast winds, becoming light and variable for a time mid-to-late afternoon, then veering fresh to strong west. Maximum temperature 10°C. Comments: Strong winds. Risk of coastal overtopping at high tide (~13:45).
